chunks: They are the patient, the sincere and devout, full of charity, who pray for forgiveness in the hours of dawn.

key_terms.بِالْأَسْحَارِ: In the hours of dawn/late night

ai.seo_question: What are the key characteristics of the righteous believers mentioned in this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to highlight the spiritual discipline of the Ahl al-Bayt and the Imams, particularly their night prayers (Tahajjud) and seeking forgiveness (Istighfar) in the quiet hours before dawn. The term 'al-asihar' (late night) is interpreted not just as a time, but as a state of spiritual vigilance and intimacy with the Divine, reinforcing the connection between moral rectitude and consistent ritual practice.
